newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain- Soy offers rise in nearbys.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain- Soy offers rise in nearbys.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers rose in nearby positions on Thursday while corn values were steady to slightly lower, dealers said.
Dealers cited a lack of nearby soybean supplies to meet export needs and the continued volatility of the August/November spread on the Chicago Board of Trade behind the jump in FOB soybean values.

Concerns of tight old-crop soybean supplies drove CBOT August soybean futures sharply higher this week, and more volatility was expected before the contract expires on Wednesday, August 20, oilseeds analysts said.
On the export front, Pakistan later this month will seek about 350,000 tonnes of optional origin soft white wheat for September 11-October 10 delivery, a Pakistan embassy official said.
